title: Richard NDE 7432/22974 NDE 22974
content:
7432 I was about to die and was in an Emergency room. My heart rate was 180 beats per minute. They shot me full of drugs to try and chemically convert my heart twice. When that didn't work they gave me more drugs to knock me out, put large pads on my chest and back and then I passed out. They said it took much more than usual to put me out. I have never been a drug user, but I do have some kind of high immunity to Anesthetic drugs. At that point they said they sent electricity several times into me to "convert my heart." At one point my heart stopped beating for one minute eleven seconds I was told. What I experienced. I was on a path that had a hard packed dirt floor. It looked like a cave, however it had varying shaped openings in the left wall. The right side wall was like any cave I had ever seen both in pictures and had been in in my youth. The roof of this cave like place had something that reminded me of a trellis or even mineshaft roof supports. I was walking this path and as I looked through the holes in the left wall I noticed that the area I could see outside looked like some sort of desert, very much like the ones in the western part of the united states, but it all had an intense pinkish hue that seemed to envelop it. It was devoid of structures or human and animal life, but seem to have plant life of a sorts. Ahead of me were two groups of people that seemed to be dressed all the same, and as far as I could tell they seemed female and I did not recognize any of them. I remember I was trying to walk as fast as I could, but it was like I never gained any real ground for some time even though they appeared to be no more than thirty yards or so beyond where I was. When I finally did arrive to where these two equal in number groups were; they were debating or arguing. The moment I arrived I remember feeling astonished at all that was happening and to find people. I remember being sure that I had in fact died in the emergency room, and to my amazement finding that there was life and consciousness even though I knew I was dead. When I did arrive to stand next to these two groups of people it was as if it took no real time at all to reach the people ahead of me even though it had felt like a giant struggle to do so. I can still here the sound of my voice as I asked them "who are you people?" It is a sound of disbelief that something I believed not possible turns out to be proof, positive true. I could make out very little of what they were saying, but one group seemed to trying to make the other group understand that "I was a traitor" while the other spokesperson for the opposing group asked for an exception. I no sooner got out the question of "who are you people", then suddenly I was awake in the emergency trauma room and still on the trauma table. I was admitted for a few days, sent home and one week later had a stroke, but I'm still alive so I thought I would share this with others to see if any others have seen this place.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A cave-like passage/path with a hard packed dirt floor, trellis/mineshaft-like roof supports, and openings in the left wall looking out to a pink-hued desert.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Tried to walk fast but 'never gained any real ground' for some time; then it was as if it took no time at all to reach the groups ahead.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two groups of people, seemingly female, dressed the same; debating/arguing. The experiencer did not recognize them.

environment.environment_other_detail: Cave-like interior path; openings in left wall; outside looked like a desert (western US-like) with an intense pinkish hue; no structures; no human/animal life; some plant life.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency room event with very high heart rate; chemically and electrically cardioverted; heart stopped for 1 minute 11 seconds.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered two groups of unknown people (not recognized as loved ones) arguing; asked, 'who are you people?'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE described; transitioned directly into a cave-like passage/path, then encountered groups of people, then abruptly returned to the trauma room.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Cave-like corridor with openings to a pink-hued desert; two equal groups of similarly dressed (seemingly female) people arguing about the experiencer being 'a traitor' and asking for 'an exception.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "who are you people?"; "I was a traitor"; asked for "an exception"; heart stopped "for one minute eleven seconds".
